text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship is injured, so I bring her to the

infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Damage minimal. Mission can be resumed at will. Awaiting commander's orders. Beep, beep.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Commencing secondary scan... Beep. Mission can be resumed at will. Requesting new orders.
choice_data_list: ダメージ個所の修復が先
今すぐプログラムをアップグレードしよう！
choice_data_list_en: Repairing the damaged spots comes first.
Let's upgrade your program right away!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon! I'm fine, I tell you!
choice_data_list: 却下、修復を優先とする

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now they're official orders? Drat. Can't
override
those even if I wanted to...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Order acknowledged. Prioritizing repairs... Beep, beep, beep...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship isn't happy about being put
on bed rest
for a few days and goes wild
once she makes a
full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Suggestion approved. Golshiroid,
initiating
upgrade sequence!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What gives?! Everything was fine just a
second
ago...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Great, now I'm just a pile of scrap. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her self-diagnostics clearly didn't
produce good
results, because she
suddenly gets eerily quiet.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Approved. The current operating
program can
only be upgraded under
one condition.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Beep-beep. Ice cream from the school store is required to upgrade Golshiroid. Otherwise, update will be postponed indefinitely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no getting around it. I accept her

condition, and then two of us rework her
training
schedule.
